theater: 雁門關、代州與崞縣（山西代縣）

battle.name: 雁門之戰
battle.theater: 雁門關、代州與崞縣（山西代縣）
battle.brief: 雍熙三年五月，遼聖宗與蕭太后分路南侵，蕭撻凜領前鋒精騎直趨代州、雁門，攻城失利中石而死，遼軍遂不能下關。宋軍據關固守，以城頭秦連弩與飛石壓制雲梯撞車，李繼隆部在崞縣出擊，斬首三千餘級。此役守住太原門戶，雁門關之名也自此走進楊家將的傳說。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是北宋與遼朝。北宋方面，雍熙三年朝廷以京師禁軍為骨幹，河北、山東、西北各路鎮兵與募兵為枝，總樞密院與三衙掌兵籍調發；河東防務由太原府、壽陽府與代州一線的守軍分擔，守軍以步卒與弓弩手為主，騎兵比例偏低，馬匹多自西北軍州與蕃部市易所得。北宋的戰略重心是一個「守禦」：前一年北伐失利之後，太原、代州沿線的城寨重加修葺，關隘設置弓弩手、禁兵與屯田義兵，糧秣靠河東、關中、河北三路屯田與車隊轉運，一旦前線被切斷，援軍與糧草要旬月才能接上。遼朝方面，蕭太后與聖宗耶律隆緒統軍，作戰序列以契丹本部重騎為核心，輔以奚人、渤海、漢人兵，騎兵甲胄精良，人馬皆披重甲；中軍由蕭太后自將，統軍大將蕭撻凜領前鋒精騎，另有耶律休哥、耶律斜軾等名將分統別部。遼軍自雲中、豐州（今山西大同）一線南下，東路則自雄州南下，兩路互為聲援，合兵之志直指開封，把「以戰促和」的籌碼握在自己手上。蕭撻凜一死，中軍失去最能打的前鋒，遼軍的攻勢為之一挫。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Northern Song and the Liao dynasty. On the Song side, in the third year of Yongsong the court built its armies on the capital garrison as a core, with the levies and provincial troops of Hebei, Shandong and the northwest forming the branches; the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Three Commands held the rosters and the dispatch of men. The defence of Hedong was divided between the prefecture of Taiyuan, Shouyang and the line of Daizhou, and the garrisons there were made up mainly of foot soldiers and crossbowmen, with only a small share of cavalry, since horses had to be drawn from the northwestern circuits or traded from the tribal peoples. The Song strategic idea in 980 was simply to hold: after the northern campaign of 986 had failed, the forts and walls along Taiyuan and Daizhou were repaired, the passes were manned by archers, imperial guards and locally recruited militia, and grain and fodder came from the tuntian of Hedong, Guanzhong and Hebei and from wagon convoys. If the front were cut through, relief troops and supplies would need a month or more to arrive. On the Liao side, Empress Dowager Xiao and Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, took the field in person. The order of battle centred on the armoured heavy cavalry of the Khitans themselves, supported by Xi, Bohai and Han troops; the riders were well protected, horse and man alike. The empress dowager commanded the central army, the master general Xiao Talin led the vanguard of picked cavalry, and famous commanders such as Yelü Xiuge and Yelü Xieshi led separate detachments. The Liao came down from Yungzhong and Fengzhou, the area of modern Datong in Shanxi, while another column pushed south from Xiongzhou, so that the two might support one another and converge on Kaifeng, giving the Liao the bargaining position of a war won on the field. The death of Xiao Talin removed the most formidable leading general from the Liao army and killed the momentum of the assault.
people: 宋方主導者是年約四十一歲的宋太宗趙炅。他即位四年，前一年高梁河大敗折了兵威；雍熙三年聞遼軍南下，起初打算親征河北，宰相趙普與張洎力諫止之，請以靜坐待其弊，於是改為坐鎮京師、檄令諸道兵入援，同時遣使議和。真正擋在前面的是分屬幾處的將領：河東一路有曹彬、潘美等將率西路軍趨太原、壓住遼軍西路；代州、崞縣一線則由李繼隆、劉敷、張釗等部當面拒敵。李繼隆部在崞縣大破遼軍，斬首三千餘級、擒趙福等百餘人，是此役唯一留下確數的一場戰鬥。名將楊業亦在此役現身，《宋史》本傳記其身被數創而士卒倍奮，一說其戰於雁門、崞縣一線；具體斬獲各家記載有出入，諸說並存，不宜當作定論。遼方實權在蕭太后手中，聖宗年幼但親臨前線；統軍大將蕭撻凜性剛好勇，攻城時在代州城下中飛石（一說為弩箭所中）而死，蕭太后聞訊悲慟，謂左右兩大將一時喪命、誰復能為我拒敵。戲曲與演義另立潘仁美掛帥、呼延贊與劉敬守關、蕭太后用反間等情節，與史實相去甚遠，只可當作後世想像。
peopleEn: The leading figure on the Song side was Emperor Taizong Zhao Jiong, then about forty-one years old. Four years into his reign, and with the army's confidence shattered by the defeat at Gaolianghe the year before, he first intended to campaign in person in Hebei when he learned that the Liao were moving south in the third year of Yongsong. The chancellor Zhao Pu and Zhang Ji pressed hard against it, urging him to sit still and wait for the enemy to exhaust himself, so the court instead held the capital, called in troops from the circuits, and sent envoys to talk. The men who actually stood in the front were commanders scattered along the line: on the western road into Hedong, generals such as Cao Bin and Pan Mei led the western army towards Taiyuan to pin the Liao western column; on the Daizhou and Xiaoxian front the refusal was made by the troops of Li Jilong, Liu Fu and Zhang Zhao. Li Jilong's men routed the Liao at Xiaoxian, cutting off more than three thousand heads and taking over a hundred prisoners including the Liao commander Zhao Fu, the only engagement of the campaign that has left a firm number behind. The famous general Yang Ye also appears in this war; the biography in the Song History records that he was wounded several times and that his soldiers fought with double the usual vigour, and one account places his fighting on the Yanmen and Xiaoxian line. The exact claims made for him differ from source to source, the traditions vary, and they should not be treated as settled. On the Liao side the real power lay with the empress dowager Xiao, while the young emperor Shengzong was present in the field. The master general Xiao Talin was stubborn and brave to a fault; while leading the assault at Daizhou he was struck by a flying stone, or by a crossbow bolt according to another account, and died on the spot. The empress dowager mourned him bitterly, saying to her attendants that with two great generals lost in one stroke, who would be left to hold the enemy off for her. The theatre and the novels add a commander named Pan Renmei, a garrison of Huyan Zan and Liu Jing, and a scheme of the empress dowager playing one side against the other; all of this is invention set far from the record and may be read only as later imagination.
kits: 卡面所配的秦連弩，是漢代已定型、以弩機蓄力而能連發的重型弩機；到唐宋，它仍是關城與城頭壓制攻城人馬的標準器械。在本役中，它扮演的是守方火力的骨幹：雁門關與代州一線的敵樓、箭樓上架設連弩與床弩，專射遼軍的雲梯、撞車以及列陣逼近的步騎；連發的弩機使守軍在數量劣勢下仍能維持連續的箭幕，並與弓兵、步卒的長槍陣互相覆蓋，把攻城者壓在牆外難以抬頭。攻城一方則依靠投石飛石、撞車、雲梯與皮索絞盤，試圖在牆根堆積攻城器材並壓制城頭射手；配石包的投石機在唐代已是破城利器，遼軍是否攜帶成組的攻城器械，史料記載有限，只可從其攻關受阻、屯兵日久推知器械數量不少。除了弩機，雙方尚有長槍、刀、盾與弓箭：遼軍的鐵甲重騎與宋軍的神臂弓、硬弓構成攻守兩端的火力骨架；宋軍缺馬，步卒與弓弩手比例偏高，騎兵只作側擊與追擊之用，糧秣則由真定、正定一線北運至代州。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card face was the heavy crossbow with a trigger mechanism that stored the draw and could fire several bolts in succession, a form already settled in the Han period and still the standard piece for a garrison to hold down the men at the foot of a wall in Tang and Song times. In this campaign it formed the backbone of the defenders' firepower: on the enemy towers and arrow lofts of Yanmen Pass and of the Daizhou line, repeating crossbows and bed crossbows were set up to shoot at the Liao ladders, battering rams and the infantry and cavalry that closed up in formation. A crossbow that could fire continuously allowed a small garrison to keep up a continuous curtain of bolts even when it was outnumbered, and that curtain interlocked with the long-spear formations of the foot soldiers and the archers, keeping the assaulting troops pinned outside the wall where they could not raise their heads. The side doing the assault relied on stone-throwing engines, battering rams, scaling ladders and winch-driven catapults to pile up equipment against the foot of the wall and to pin down the archers on the ramparts. The stone-throwing engine with its stone bag and leather sling had been a proven battering tool since the Tang. Whether the Liao brought whole trains of such machines is thinly recorded; it can only be inferred from the fact that the siege dragged on and the troops stayed before the walls for a long time, which implies that the siege train was no small thing. Besides the crossbows, both sides had long spears, sabres, shields and bows. The Liao armoured heavy cavalry and the Song divine-arm bow and strong bow formed the two ends of the firepower spectrum. The Song lacked horses, so foot soldiers and crossbowmen carried the day and the cavalry were used only for flank attacks and pursuit, while grain and fodder were carried north from the Zhending and Zhengding lines to Daizhou.
tactics: 遼軍的戰術是分路合擊與速戰速決。蕭太后自將中軍直趨代州、雁門，前鋒蕭撻凜以精騎先行，直抵城下，試圖以一日之間破關；東路自雄州南下者則直趨河北平原，形成南北對進、遙相威脅開封之勢。攻城本身以撞車、飛石與密集步卒列陣推進為主，前鋒以盾車結陣抵住守軍的箭矢，後方弓弩掩護，試圖把守軍釘死在城頭上。但遼軍的戰役結構有先天弱點：前鋒一旦陷在城下，糧道便從雲中一路拉長，而中軍主力離前鋒越遠，越難在關下集中兵力。宋軍這邊採的是典型的城池消耗戰：代州、崞縣、雁門關互相策應，關上以連弩與飛石封住通道，城下不與遼軍爭一時之勝負；李繼隆部不與遼軍爭攻城正面，而是以騎兵在崞縣一帶襲擊遼軍的側翼與輜重，一戰斬首三千餘級，打斷其攻勢。宋太宗本人未至前線，採趙普之謀，以「據城以老」消耗遼軍銳氣，同時以遣使議和爭取時間，讓遼軍在久攻不下、援兵齊集的情況下自行退兵。
tacticsEn: The Liao plan was to converge from several roads and to force a quick decision. The empress dowager led the central army straight at Daizhou and Yanmen, while Xiao Talin took the picked cavalry of the vanguard forward to the foot of the pass in the hope of breaking it within a single day. The eastern column coming down from Xiongzhou drove at the Hebei plain, so that the two armies converged from north and south and together threatened Kaifeng. The siege itself was carried out with battering rams, stone-throwing engines and dense infantry formations: the leading elements closed up behind shield carts to take the weight of the defenders' arrows, with archers behind them covering the advance, in the hope of pinning the garrison down on the ramparts. Yet the Liao structure of operations carried an inherent weakness. Once the vanguard was stuck below the pass, the supply line was stretched all the way back to Yungzhong, and the further the central army stood from the vanguard the harder it was to concentrate force under the walls. The Song answer was the classical defence by attrition through walled towns. Daizhou, Xiaoxian and Yanmen Pass supported one another in a chain, the pass was sealed with repeating crossbows and stones while the Song declined to meet the Liao in the open below the walls, and Li Jilong's command did not contest the Liao face-on but struck the flank and the baggage train around Xiaoxian, cutting off more than three thousand heads in a single action and breaking the momentum of the assault. The emperor himself never came to the front; following the counsel of Zhao Pu he meant to wear the Liao down by holding his cities and to gain time through envoys, letting the enemy withdraw once the siege had dragged on and the Song relief armies had closed up.
data: 時間上，此役自雍熙三年四月遼軍出動，到六月全軍北撤，前後約兩個月，主戰集中在五月。兵力數字各方記載相差很遠：遼軍多記作「號稱十萬」，亦有二十萬之說；宋太宗聞警後自京師發禁軍，並檄河北、山東、河南各路入援，總數亦多作十餘萬計。這些多屬行軍時的號令數與誇大之辭，不宜當作實點。較可依據的是《宋史·李繼隆傳》所記崞縣一戰斬首三千餘級、擒遼將趙福等百餘人，這是本役唯一有具體數目的戰果。地理上，雁門關距代州城約二十餘公里，關城南倚山嶺，北臨黑河與塞外草場，設內外兩重，現存磚城為明代重修，周長約一千五百米，格局仍沿唐宋舊制；雁門關是內三關（雁門、寧武、偏頭）之一，控扼太原的北面門戶，關內外可屯兵萬餘。糧秣方面，河北諸路以屯田與漕運供給，軍需車隊由真定、正定一線北運至代州，前線存糧撐不過一季，便要靠太原倉廩接濟。城防器械的耗量史無明細，但可推知飛石與箭矢在兩個月的攻防中消耗極大。
dataEn: As to time, the campaign ran from the month of April in the third year of Yongsong, when the Liao army set out, to the month of June, when it withdrew to the north, something like two months in all, with the main fighting in May. The strength figures differ widely from source to source: the Liao host is most often recorded as numbering ten myriads by proclamation, and there are also statements of two hundred thousand. After the alarm, Song Taizong sent out the capital garrison and summoned troops from the circuits of Hebei, Shandong and Henan, the total likewise given as a hundred thousand odd. Most of these are order-of-battle proclamations and exaggerations and should not be taken as actual counts. Far more reliable is the record in the biography of Li Jilong in the Song History that the battle at Xiaoxian cut off more than three thousand heads and took over a hundred Liao prisoners including the commander Zhao Fu; this is the only firm number attached to the campaign. As to geography, Yanmen Pass stands some twenty-odd kilometres from the walled town of Daizhou, its south side against the mountains and its north over the Black River and the pastures beyond the frontier, laid out in an inner and an outer enceinte. The brick wall that survives today was rebuilt in the Ming and runs for about fifteen hundred metres, but the layout still follows the Tang and Song arrangement. Yanmen was one of the three inner passes, with Yanmen, Ningwu and Piantou, and it controlled the northern approach to Taiyuan; more than ten thousand men could be quartered inside and around the pass. As to supply, Hebei furnished grain through tuntian and canal transport, and the military wagons ran north from the Zhending and Zhengding lines to Daizhou; what the front held in store was good for no more than a season before the granaries of Taiyuan had to make up the difference. No detailed figures survive for the consumption of siege equipment, but the stones and bolts expended over two months of attack must have been enormous.
cause: 直接起因是遼軍主動南侵。979年宋太宗趁滅北漢之勢北伐燕雲，兵敗於高梁河，河北門戶洞開，遼軍乘勝南下至澶州、魏州，宋廷不得不重新部署。兩年之後，蕭太后判斷宋軍新敗、元氣未復、內部對北伐與守禦尚有爭議，於是傾力來攻：她要的不是占地，而是用一場速勝逼宋廷認輸、換取一份對等的和約；同時藉此試探宋軍新整的防線究竟有多厚。深層原因則是燕雲十六州的歸屬。十六州在後晉時期被割予契丹，宋廷一直視之為失地，「收復燕雲」是太宗一朝的執念；遼廷則明白宋軍只要整頓完成就會再來，因此寧可先發制人，把戰爭推到河北平原上去。此外還有宋廷內部的路線分歧：趙普、張洎主張持重、議和、固守河東，而太宗本人與一批近臣仍想著北伐。雍熙三年之役正是在這兩種取向之間的一次實戰校準，也是高梁河慘敗之後宋廷必須補上的那一課。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a Liao offensive of their own. In 979 Song Taizong, riding on the fall of Northern Han, had campaigned north into the Yanyun sixteen prefectures and been beaten at Gaolianghe; the Hebei gateways had been left open and the Liao had ridden on to Song and Wei prefectures, forcing the Song court to redeploy. Two years later the empress dowager Xiao judged that the Song army was fresh from defeat, had not recovered its strength, and was still arguing at home between northern campaigning and plain defence, so she came with everything she had. What she wanted was not territory. She wanted a quick victory that would force the Song court to give in and buy a peace treaty on equal terms, and at the same time she wanted to find out how thick the newly reorganised Song defences really were. The deeper cause lay in the ownership of the Yanyun sixteen prefectures. Those prefectures had been ceded to the Khitans under Later Jin, the Song court had always treated them as lost land, and the recovery of Yanyun was the standing obsession of Taizong's reign. The Liao court understood equally well that once the Song had finished reorganising it would come again, and so preferred to strike first and carry the war out onto the Hebei plain. There was also a division of counsel inside the Song: Zhao Pu and Zhang Ji argued for caution, for negotiation and for holding the Hedong line, while the emperor and a circle of close ministers still dreamed of a campaign to the north. The fighting of 980 was the working out of those two temperaments in the field, and the lesson the Song had to learn after the disaster at Gaolianghe.
impact: 此役的第一個後果，是宋遼之間的戰略平衡向「宋守遼攻」傾斜了二十餘年。蕭太后在折了大將蕭撻凜之後改弦更張，轉向以和議與互市換取邊境安寧；遼軍此後雖仍時有南下抄掠，大規模南征卻要等到景德元年（1004）才再出現。宋廷則在河東留下一整套以城為本的防禦體系：代州、崞縣、雁門關一線增築城砦、儲備弓弩與石彈，屯田與漕運配合，之後的雍熙北伐正是建立在這套體系之上。另一層影響在後世的記憶：雁門關從此成為抵禦北方入侵的象徵，楊家將故事在此生根，楊六郎、呼延贊、蕭太后等人物被寫入話本、雜劇與戲曲，演義把一場有史料可考的邊境攻防改寫成巾幗英雄的傳奇。史實與演義在此交疊，既令雁門之名歷久不衰，也使後人難以從傳說中分離出這場戰役的真實面貌。而《宋史》等書流傳下來的記載本身也多有訛舛，諸說並存，讀史者需要分辨哪些是朝廷的記功之辭，哪些是後人追寫。
impactEn: The first consequence of the campaign was that the strategic balance between Song and Liao tilted towards a Song that defended and a Liao that attacked, for more than twenty years. After losing the master general Xiao Talin the empress dowager changed her tune and turned to peace talks and border trade in exchange for quiet on the frontier. The Liao still raided south from time to time, but the next large-scale invasion did not come until 1004. On the Song side the campaign left behind a whole system of defence in Hedong built on towns: forts were raised along the Daizhou, Xiaoxian and Yanmen line, crossbows and stone ammunition were stockpiled, and tuntian was matched to canal transport. The northern campaign of 986 was in turn built on that system. The other layer of the impact lies in later memory. Yanmen Pass became the symbol of resistance to invasion from the north, the Yang family saga took root there, and figures such as Yang Liulang, Huyan Zan and the empress dowager were written into storybooks, plays and operas, the romance cycle recasting a border engagement that the records can document as a war of soldiers and engines into a legend of heroines. History and romance overlap at Yanmen: they have kept the name alive for a thousand years, and at the same time they make it hard for later readers to separate the real shape of the campaign from the tale. The transmitted accounts themselves, in the Song History and elsewhere, contain many errors, and the traditions vary; anyone reading them has to separate the court's commemorations from later embellishment.
result: 結局是遼軍攻而不克，全軍北撤，宋軍守住了雁門關與代州、崞縣一線。五月間蕭撻凜在代州城下中石而死，遼軍前鋒喪氣，隨後又遭李繼隆部在崞縣側擊，斬首三千餘級，攻勢遂中止。蕭太后得知蕭撻凜陣亡與攻城失利之後，終止南進，六月下令班師；宋太宗也不追擊，詔令諸軍固守關防，同時遣使議和，雙方各持文書，戰事就此收束。這是一場沒有割地、沒有賠款的邊界消耗戰：遼軍主力未曾突破河東防線，開封未受威脅；宋軍也沒有取得任何反攻的機會，只是把高梁河之敗以後的士氣重新穩住。從更長的視角看，此役是宋遼之間最後一場大規模對抗的序曲——六年之後的雍熙北伐會證明，單靠城池與守禦並不能換來燕雲；而本役守住的雁門關，又在二十四年後成為宋遼訂立澶淵之盟時彼此默契的邊界背景。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Liao army failed to take the pass and withdrew north in full, while the Song held the line of Yanmen Pass, Daizhou and Xiaoxian. In May Xiao Talin was struck by a stone and died below the walls of Daizhou, the Liao vanguard lost heart, and the army was then struck in the flank at Xiaoxian by Li Jilong's command, which cut off more than three thousand heads; the assault stalled. Once the empress dowager learned both of Xiao Talin's death and the failure of the siege, she halted the advance and ordered the army home in June. Song Taizong did not pursue. He ordered the troops to hold the passes, sent envoys to negotiate, and the two sides exchanged documents; the fighting was over. It was a war of exhaustion along a frontier with no land ceded and no indemnity paid. The main Liao host never broke through the Hedong defences and Kaifeng was never threatened; the Song gained no chance to counterattack either, and simply recovered the morale it had lost at Gaolianghe. Seen from further back, the campaign was the prelude to the last great confrontation between Song and Liao. The northern campaign of 986, six years later, was to show that cities and a defensive posture alone could not recover Yanyun. And the Yanmen Pass held in 980 stood in the background, twenty-four years later, as the frontier both sides tacitly accepted when they concluded the Chanyuan peace.
